..name: fhevm-sdk-workspace
..note: Declares the member list and the toolchain every member shares. Not a member of anything itself.

./common.name: @fhevm/sdk-common-dev
./common.note: Importable only by code that is itself never published; a published package importing it would ship an unresolvable specifier.

./common-vendored.name: @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev
./common-vendored.note: Source of truth for files that are copied rather than imported. Its manifest.json drives `fhevm-npm sync-vendored`.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v12.name: @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext-v12-dev
./host-contracts-cleartext/v12.note: Older generation. Reachable as @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext-v12-dev/pkg/... only because this manifest declares no `exports`.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v12/pkg.name: @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext
./host-contracts-cleartext/v12/pkg.note: Deliberately not a member: it shares its published name with v13/pkg, and listing both would make that name ambiguous.

vendored.reason: Upstream ships Solidity with no npm package a consumer could import, so the sources are copied and frozen per generation.
A published package cannot depend on the private @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev, so it receives a copy instead.
The TypeScript face of sdk/cleartext-config.json, generated by `fhevm-npm generate-cleartext-config` into common-vendored/src and copied here for the same cannot-depend-on-private reason.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v12/pkg/ts.note: Sets the module type for the optional TypeScript layer inside the published package.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v12/test-cons.name: host-contracts-cleartext-v12-consumer-cjs
./host-contracts-cleartext/v12/test-cons.note: A standard external CommonJS TypeScript consumer copied to a temporary directory by the owning dev package's test:consumer script.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v12/test-cons.name: host-contracts-cleartext-v12-consumer-esm
./host-contracts-cleartext/v12/test-cons.note: A standard external ESM TypeScript consumer copied to a temporary directory by the owning dev package's test:consumer script.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v13.name: @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext-v13-dev
./host-contracts-cleartext/v13.note: Current generation, and the reference implementation every older generation is derived from.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v13/pkg.name: @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext
./host-contracts-cleartext/v13/pkg.note: The only generation whose published package is a member, so the shared name resolves to exactly one directory.

vendored.reason: Upstream ships Solidity with no npm package a consumer could import, so the sources are copied and frozen per generation.
A published package cannot depend on the private @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev, so it receives a copy instead.
The TypeScript face of sdk/cleartext-config.json, generated by `fhevm-npm generate-cleartext-config` into common-vendored/src and copied here for the same cannot-depend-on-private reason.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v13/pkg/ts.note: Sets the module type for the optional TypeScript layer inside the published package.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v13/test-cons.name: host-contracts-cleartext-v13-consumer-cjs
./host-contracts-cleartext/v13/test-cons.note: A standard external CommonJS TypeScript consumer copied to a temporary directory by the owning dev package's test:consumer script.

./host-contracts-cleartext/v13/test-cons.name: host-contracts-cleartext-v13-consumer-esm
./host-contracts-cleartext/v13/test-cons.note: A standard external ESM TypeScript consumer copied to a temporary directory by the owning dev package's test:consumer script.

./hardhat/v2.name: fhevm-hardhat-v2-workspace
./hardhat/v2.note: Installation root for the hardhat v2 generation (a CLUSTER): one npm workspace with its own lockfile and hoisting, so every member resolves the SAME hardhat@2 — the no-symlink singleton guarantee. One installation root per hardhat major; the sdk root workspace holds no hardhat at all.

./hardhat/v2/plugin.name: @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-v2-dev
./hardhat/v2/plugin.note: Declares no `version`, which the version rule says should be 0.0.0.

vendored.reason: A published package cannot depend on the private @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev; the copy's sibling type import is rewritten to @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext.

./hardhat/v2/fhevm-hardhat-template.name: @fhevm/hardhat-template-v2-dev
./hardhat/v2/fhevm-hardhat-template.note: Dev owner for the template. Owns the outbound render spec (mirror.manifest.json) that turns the workspace-native ./pkg into the public repository.

./hardhat/v2/fhevm-hardhat-template/pkg.name: fhevm-hardhat-template-v2
./hardhat/v2/fhevm-hardhat-template/pkg.note: The WORKSPACE-NATIVE template: an ordinary cluster member, free to differ from the public repository — github.com/zama-ai/fhevm-hardhat-template is a RENDER of it (publish-mirror), produced from the owner's mirror.manifest.json: registry dependency ranges for the file: links, solhint and its configs re-added, CI extras, regenerated lockfile. The rendered artifact is the read-only thing, not this copy; consumer fidelity is proven by test-consumer against the render.

./hardhat/v2/e2e.name: @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-v2-e2e-dev
./hardhat/v2/e2e.note: Links the plugin as a cluster member rather than installing a tarball; the packed-artifact check lives in the template instead.

./hardhat/v3.name: fhevm-hardhat-v3-workspace
./hardhat/v3.note: Installation root for the hardhat v3 generation (a CLUSTER): its own lockfile pins hardhat 3.x, hoisted once for every member — the same no-symlink singleton guarantee as ./hardhat/v2, one root per hardhat major. The fhevm-hardhat-template sibling joins its workspaces when it lands.

./hardhat/v3/plugin.name: @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-v3-dev
./hardhat/v3/plugin.note: Dev owner of the hardhat v3 plugin (lint, tests, consumer fixture, packaging checks). Declares no `version`, which the version rule says should be 0.0.0.

./hardhat/v3/plugin/pkg.name: @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-v3
./hardhat/v3/plugin/pkg.note: One published package per hardhat generation: the v2 payload stays @fhevm/hardhat-plugin, this one is @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-v3, versioned on the FHEVM protocol line it targets (0.13.x).

vendored.reason: A published package cannot depend on the private @fhevm/sdk-vendored-dev; the copy's sibling type import is rewritten to @fhevm/host-contracts-cleartext.

./hardhat/v3/e2e.name: @fhevm/hardhat-plugin-v3-e2e-dev
./hardhat/v3/e2e.note: The v3 twin of ./hardhat/v2/e2e: links the plugin as a cluster member. Born with the v2 Solidity corpus and one test; each v2 test file ports as the plugin surface it needs lands.

./hardhat/v3/plugin/test-consumer/esm.name: hardhat-plugin-v3-consumer-esm
./hardhat/v3/plugin/test-consumer/esm.note: Isolated ESM consumer fixture for the v3 plugin, copied to a temporary directory by test-consumer.
